Every mark self-contained with a safe transparent border. Luminous pearl silver, ice-blue shadows, white hot centers and pale mint light; renderer will recolor glow per vehicle. No vehicle, people, lettering, symbols, interface, stage, ground depiction, opaque backdrop, black rectangle or multi-frame sheet. Outside and openings absolutely transparent. ENTRANCE GATE layer. Rim has a vivid thick low rim and a thin far rim conveying depth, and a few sizeable silhouette fragments leaving orbit. The MOUTH is a wide fully transparent hole (at least 53% of width), ready for a vehicle to emerge through. The eye sees a sculptural portal with detailed lit surfaces, not a flat logo or single neon line.
